svg.title: Attention heads in parallel
svg.desc: Attention heads working in parallel. The input, 5 tokens (The cat sat on the) by 768 numbers, goes to every head at the same time. Head 1 links back to "cat"; head 2 looks at the word before; head 3 looks at the first word. Each has its own query, key and value, and a look-back grid where later words are masked. Heads 4 to 12 run at the same time too. Each head outputs 5 by 64 numbers. The 12 outputs are joined side by side, 12 times 64 equals 768, then mixed by one learned layer into an output of 5 by 768, the same shape as the input. Numbers from GPT-2.
svg.text: Every head reads the same tokens at the same time. Their outputs are placed side by side, then mixed into one.
⋯ heads 4 to 12, all at the same time
Numbers from GPT-2: 12 heads of 64 numbers each. Grids: darker = more attention; grey = later words, masked.
